definitions.explanation: A man with attractive physical features. Somewhat literary or formal compared to everyday terms like イケメン.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美男|びなん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: He is famous for being handsome.

examples.japanese: {美男|びなん}⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧だ。
examples.english: They are a couple of a handsome man and a beautiful woman.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美男|びなん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{演技力|えんぎりょく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: That actor is known as a handsome man, but he also has great acting ability.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beautiful) + {男|なん} (man). A classical-sounding word for a good-looking man. The fuller form {美男子|びなんし} is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美男|びなん}⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧: handsome man and beautiful woman (an attractive couple)
- {美男子|びなんし}: handsome man (slightly more emphatic)
- {美男|びなん}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: handsome actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: good-looking guy — casual, modern slang; the most common everyday term
- ⟦{男前|おとこまえ}→男前：13569_otokomae⟧: handsome, manly — emphasizes masculine attractiveness
- ⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧: beautiful woman — the female counterpart
